name: Phosphor Trail
description: A luminous ribbon follows the pointer along its recent path. The ribbon is widest and brightest at the pointer and tapers away with age, wrapped in a soft glow halo. Its colour runs through the brand spectrum from the head colour at the pointer to the tail colour at the far end, and it grows wider and brighter when the pointer moves fast.
author: PlasmaZones

parameters.name: Lifetime
parameters.description: How long a point on the path stays lit (seconds)

parameters.name: Glow
parameters.description: Strength of the soft halo around the ribbon, 0 to disable

parameters.name: Speed boost
parameters.description: How much wider and brighter the ribbon gets when the pointer moves fast

parameters.name: Head colour
parameters.description: Colour at the pointer end of the ribbon

parameters.name: Tail colour
parameters.description: Colour at the fading end of the ribbon
